name: [ELITEA-1899] test_agent_icon_change_persists_on_list_card
description: Selecting a new icon in the picker updates the header immediately and the identical icon persists on the agent's dashboard card. Currently SANCTIONED RED on the "immediately" half — open product defect #2055 (see module docstring): the header ```` is not rendered until a reload. Those two assertions are soft-aggregated and still assert the correct behaviour; everything else is hard and green.
descriptionHtml:
Selecting a new icon in the picker updates the header immediately
and the identical icon persists on the agent's dashboard card.

    Currently SANCTIONED RED on the "immediately" half — open product
    defect #2055 (see module docstring): the header ``<img>`` is not
    rendered until a reload. Those two assertions are soft-aggregated and
    still assert the correct behaviour; everything else is hard and green.

steps.name: Precondition — create a dedicated disposable agent
Step 1 — Navigate to the agent detail page
Step 2 — Click the agent icon (hover first) — icon picker opens
Step 3 — Select a different icon from the picker
Step 4 — New icon is shown in the agent header immediately (no reload)
Step 4b — TRANSIT (declared, works around #2055): reload so the already-persisted icon renders, giving Steps 5-7 a real system-produced reference URL

Step 5 — CLARIFICATION (issue #566, not a defect): the icon change already persisted via its own PUT call in Step 3 — there is no separate 'click Save' action for this field. The main Save button stays disabled after an icon-only change since the icon field is not formik-tracked
Step 6 — Navigate to the Agents dashboard
Step 7 — Agent card shows the newly selected icon (exact src match)
Side-channel check — no unexpected console errors across the flow
